items.title: Walmart (WMT) Brings Nationwide Restaurant Delivery To Its App With A New Deal
items.summary: Walmart (NasdaqGS:WMT) has partnered with Inspire Brands to offer nationwide delivery of Dunkin’ products through the Walmart app and website. The agreement expands Walmart's restaurant delivery offering by adding Dunkin’ food and beverages alongside existing quick service partners. Customers can order Dunkin’ items for delivery using Walmart's last mile network, integrating restaurant orders with their regular Walmart shopping.
